SR-2.source: NASA TM X-73612 (Mikkelson et al. 1977) figure 13(c), traced (gridless; calibration from the t/b and r/R ticks)
notes: The other scales of fig. 13(c) share the t/b axis: b/D = 0.04 + 0.5 y, CLD = -0.3 + 5 y, dbeta = -12 + 200 y.
dbeta reads -0.11 deg at 0.75R (0 by definition).
b/D past 0.947R (the steep drop to the tip) read by eye: 0.100 at 0.97R, 0.060 at 1.0.
t/b inboard of 0.35R traced row by row (the curve is near vertical).
Sections: modified NACA 65 with circular-arc camber to 0.37R, NACA 16 from 0.53R, a transition between; integrated design CL 0.08, AF 203 (TM X-73612).

SR-3.source: NASA CR-3505 (Rohrbach et al. 1982) figures 16 (b/D, t/b, CLD, dbeta) and 17 (aerodynamic sweep), traced on the grid with the grid removed by a binary opening
notes: Scales of fig. 16: CLD = -0.4 + 5 y, dbeta = -10 + 250 y (y on the b/D, t/b scale).
t/b inboard of 0.305R traced row by row; the trace reaches 0.24 at 0.242R.
b/D traced to 0.986R; 0.070 at the tip from the figure.
Sweep: the aerodynamic sweep line, -11 deg at the root, 0 at 0.39R, 46 deg at 0.95R.
Coefficients use the reference diameter 62.23 cm; the true diameter grows with blade angle (CR-3505 fig. 14).
Sections: NACA 65/CA to 0.37R, NACA 16 from 0.53R; AF 235, integrated design CL 0.241 (fig. 16).

nacelle_local_axial_mach_M0_0.8.source: TM X-73612 figure 11: potential flow about the 0.35 D nacelle near the blade leading edge, M0 = 0.8

SR-3_true_diameter.source: CR-3505 figure 14, the design-rpm line, read by eye (the static line is about 0.3% lower)
